label: GF Companion
description:
Race-ready graphical power pacing guide for Hammerhead Karoo 3.

• Semicircular Power Gauge: Live needle against red/yellow/green target zones with giant current watts, target band, and LOW/HIGH alerts.
• Zone-Colored Telemetry: Large unitless HR, Cadence, and Step Average Power with icons and optional Karoo-standard zone backgrounds (plus 80–95 rpm green cadence band).
• Route-Driven Power Segments: Automatically reads power targets from your route waypoints (e.g. "Puerto Chapelco (175-190W)") and shows the next checkpoint ahead.
• CueSheet+ Integration & Pacing Plan: Tap the NEXT card to jump straight to waypoint details & ETA in Karoo Cue Sheet+, or view the in-field Pacing Plan.
• Adaptive & Localized: Full, half, wide, and compact layouts in Day/Night themes (EN / ES / PT).
releaseNotes:
v1.0.0 — Initial public release of Karoo GF Companion:
• Semicircular 5-zone power pacing gauge with live needle, target band, and LOW/HIGH badges.
• Large unitless HR, Cadence, and Step Avg Power tiles with icons and optional Karoo-standard zone-colored backgrounds (5- and 7-zone profiles + 80–95 rpm green cadence band).
• Automatic route waypoint power target parsing (e.g. "Subida Machonico (195-210W)") and upcoming checkpoint card.
• Tap NEXT card for direct Karoo Cue Sheet+ detail/ETA link or in-field Pacing Plan overlay.
• Adaptive Full, Half, Wide, and Compact layouts with Auto Day/Night themes and EN/ES/PT localization.
